source: manual ingest from communityworks.org.uk/help-guidance/funding-and-income/ (Brighton & Hove CVS aggregator) — supplements SCF Brighton & Hove Legacy Fund
ingest_protocol_reminders: external_id prefix `staged-bh-` for Brighton & Hove local funds.

Re-categorised from original 'B&H Council' scope: Community Works (the Brighton CVS) is the aggregator hub; the funds listed are typically corporate-CSR, community pitch competitions, or local trusts rather than council-administered. Captures the same cohort intent (Brighton-local depth for Member A) more reliably than chasing council .gov.uk pages.

3 currently open: Buses Community Support Fund (deadline 30/06/2026), Brighton Soup (10/06/2026 pitch), Pebble Trust (19/06/2026). 2 rolling/uncertain timing: MADL Nisa, Morrisons Foundation. Plus Asda Foundation deferred (next round Autumn 2026).

rows.title: Brighton & Hove Buses Community Support Fund
rows.description: Community Support Fund from Brighton & Hove Buses. Awards £50–£500 in cash or equivalent bus tickets. Priority for groups combating isolation and loneliness in the Brighton & Hove Buses network area.
eligibility_criteria: Operating within Brighton & Hove Buses network area

raw_data.in_kind_alternative: bus tickets equivalent to cash value

rows.title: Brighton Soup
rows.description: Community pitch competition. Applicants pitch their community project at a Brighton Soup event; attendees pay to attend and vote on the winning project. Up to £1,000 awarded.
eligibility_criteria: Willing to pitch in person at event

rows.title: The Pebble Trust
rows.description: The Pebble Trust funds projects with long-term, broad-reaching positive impact for Brighton and Hove residents.
eligibility_criteria: Organisations serving Brighton and Hove residents
Projects with long-term, broad-reaching positive impact

rows.title: Make a Difference Locally (MADL) — Nisa Stores
rows.description: Make a Difference Locally provides grants up to £2,000 for community support, food assistance, warm spaces, and community events. Application is made through contact with a local Nisa store directly (within 10 miles of the relevant store).
eligibility_criteria: Community-based organisation within 10 miles of a local Nisa store
Causes: community support, food assistance, warm spaces, community events

raw_data.geographic_scope_note: Brighton & Hove application is location-based — 10 miles of Brighton-area Nisa stores

rows.title: Morrisons Foundation — Brighton Store
rows.description: Morrisons Foundation supports registered charities working on poverty reduction, community spaces, and health and wellbeing. Brighton store-specific contact via community.brighton@morrisonsplc.co.uk.
eligibility_criteria: Themes: poverty reduction, community spaces, health and wellbeing

raw_data.restriction_note: Registered charities only — excludes CICs, community groups. NOT eligible for Member A (CIC). Catalogue still lists for charity-cohort coverage.
